faq.title: Questions
faq.1.a: We wouldn't. We haven't found any statement from the city water company that tap water is safe to drink, and travel guides for Da Nang advise bottled water.
faq.2.q: Why is there a deposit, and how do I get it back?
faq.2.a: The deposit is for the bottle: {deposits} per bottle, depending on the water. You pay it once, with your first order, and after that you only swap empty bottles for full ones. When you stop ordering, return the bottles and we give the deposit back.
faq.3.q: Can I order fewer than {minimum} bottles?
faq.3.a: No, the minimum order is {bottles}: that's what keeps delivery free.
faq.4.q: Can I switch to another brand later?
faq.4.a: Yes, but bottles are swapped only within one brand. Return your bottles, we give the deposit back, and you place a first order with the new brand.
faq.5.q: I don't have a Vietnamese bank account. How do I pay?
faq.5.a.cash: Pay the courier in cash when the water arrives.
faq.5.a.transfer: A QR bank transfer works if you have a Vietnamese bank account or an app that can pay a VietQR code.
faq.6.q: Will you carry the bottles upstairs if there's no lift?
faq.6.a: With a lift, we bring the bottles to any floor for free. Without a lift, tell us your floor in the chat and we'll agree on it.
faq.7.a.no_tap: {brands} bottles have no tap, so you need a pump or a water dispenser.
faq.7.a.pump: We sell pumps from {price}: add one to your first order.

faq.8.a: Order by {time} and we deliver the same day. Later orders arrive the next day. Working hours: {schedule}.

legal.title: Privacy, terms and complaints
legal.demo_note: This is a demo project. The delivery service is fictional, so these texts are a sample for a real business.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.privacy.paragraph.1: The site has no server and no forms. Your order is put together in your browser, and you send it to our chat yourself.
legal.privacy.paragraph.2: Your browser keeps two things on your device: the language you chose and your last sent order, including the address and the map point. We don't receive them. To erase the order, tap “Forget my order” in the order form. To erase everything, clear this site's data in your browser settings.
legal.privacy.paragraph.3: The order message goes to the messenger you pick and is handled under that messenger's rules. Our operator reads it in the chat. When you message us, we see your messenger profile and phone number, as in any chat.
legal.privacy.paragraph.4: The page counts ordering steps, such as the chosen water or the tapped messenger, without your address, location or phone number. Right now these records stay on the page and are not sent anywhere.
legal.terms.title: Terms of delivery
legal.terms.paragraph.1: Prices on the site are per bottle. The minimum order is {bottles}, and delivery is free.
legal.terms.paragraph.2: An order is confirmed when our operator replies in the chat. If anything changes, such as the price or the time, we tell you before delivery.
legal.terms.paragraph.3: The deposit is paid once per bottle with the first order and returned when you give the bottles back. Bottles are swapped within the same brand.
legal.terms.paragraph.4: You pay on delivery: {payments}. Orders placed by {time} are delivered the same day, later ones the next day.
legal.complaints.title: Complaints
legal.complaints.paragraph.1: If something went wrong, such as the wrong water, a damaged bottle, a broken seal or a late delivery, write to us in the chat where you ordered or call {phone}.
legal.complaints.paragraph.2: Add a photo of the bottle and the label: it helps us sort things out faster.
legal.complaints.paragraph.3: We reply in the same chat and offer a solution: a replacement or a refund.
